passages.note: Pierce voted Nay on the veto override of a single-subject girls'-teams sex-at-birth law (67-28, not near-unanimous); a No shows opposition to rung 4 but does not separate rungs 1-3.
passages.actor_quote: N AY - 28 Andrade Errington Hatfield Pierce
passages.tally_quote: Yea 67 Participation in school sports. (2022) Nay 28

passages.provision_quote: (b) A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.
passages.note: Enrolled text: the operative section is rung 4; the member's Nay on it shows only the side against rung 4.
Bill details page (digest, authors); names no voter and is part of the same vote record.
Forum remarks call efforts against trans people cynical and hateful and cite gender-affirming-care bills, but name no sports-eligibility clause.
News account of his opposition to a transgender bathroom bill (a different question); his quoted words name no policy clause.

rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on the 2022 veto override of HEA 1041, whose operative section bars a male by "biological sex at birth" from girls' teams, matching the rung "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth." A No shows he opposes that rule but does not choose among "without any restrictions or requirements," "after completing basic documentation," or "case by case"; his forum and news remarks are rhetorical and name no eligibility clause.

quotes.text: they no longer had the political power to attack marriage equality, so now they're attacking trans people
